title: Payout
name: dev.uap.settlement.payout
description: What a serving node, supply agent or model steward is owed for a period, and the state of its disbursement.
$comment:
The other half of the invoice. Where an invoice collects, a payout disburses, and the two are reconciled against the same verified receipt set: an exchange that bills for an impression it does not pay out on is visibly out of balance.

Rejections are itemised for the same reason they are on the invoice. A node told only that its earnings were lower than expected has no way to improve, and no reason to trust the number.

status.$comment:
accruing     period open
  pending      final, awaiting the payout run
  held         blocked on tax documentation or a fraud review; still owed
  sent         handed to the payout handler
  failed       the handler rejected it; the balance remains owed
  rolled_over  below the account minimum; carried into the next period

gross_micros.description: Before the exchange fee and any other party's share.

splits.description: How the gross was divided. Basis points sum to 10000.

withholding.description: Tax withheld at source, where the payee's jurisdiction requires it.
withholding.$comment: Paying individuals across borders is a reporting obligation, not an optional feature. An exchange operating at scale files 1099 or DAC7 returns, and needs a form on file before it can disburse.

net_micros.description: This party's share after splits and withholding. What is actually sent.

handler_reference.description: The handler's own transfer id, for tracing a payment that did not arrive.

mandate.description: AP2 settlement mandate committing to this period's verified receipt set.
